summary: Quote.split(parts) uses Money.allocate: shares differ by <=1 minor unit, sum to total. parts<1 raises ValidationError. Avoid total.times(1/n): rounding loses cents.
Split a bill across payers with Quote.split(parts), which delegates to Money.allocate: the shares sum exactly to the total, with any odd minor unit going to the first payers.
body: Replaces the times(1/n) advice. times(Decimal(1)/n) rounds each share independently, so 100 cents over 3 payers gives 33+33+33=99 and the bill comes up short. allocate is the correct choice for bill splits; times(1/n) only fits cases where every payer is meant to see the same figure.
